title: Clay Shirky on Love, Internet Style
summary: A short Supernova 2007 provocation in which Clay Shirky uses a 1300-year-old Japanese shrine, rebuilt periodically, as a metaphor for how networks change business and collective creativity.
why: HN people cite it for the Ise shrine metaphor, that function rather than original material defines identity.

quote.text: The point there is that function is also a meaningful definition of is-ness.
